cohort.source: production team_xg_match joined to raw_payload fixtures-endpoint league map
cohort.export_note: team_xg_match is live and grew during the session; this digest freezes the exported snapshot
cohort.unlabelled_league_handling: 706 fixtures carry an empty parameters.league in the source payload. They are RETAINED in the pooled primary and EXCLUDED from per-league stability reporting. This rule is frozen here, before any result access.

split.rule: kickoff_at < split => train; kickoff_at >= split => validation

min_history.rule: both teams must have >= 5 prior completed matches in the cohort strictly before kickoff; otherwise fixture is INELIGIBLE and recorded, never silently dropped

pit_rule: rolling xg_for / xg_against per team are built strictly from matches with kickoff_at < target kickoff_at; the target fixture never contributes to its own features

comparator.function: reimplementation of strategy/calibration.py::calibrate_lambdas at ea557bb8 with LambdaCalibrationParams defaults
comparator.lineup: all adjustments 0.0, both evidence gates false
comparator.apply_home_advantage: true for all cohort fixtures; neutral-site flag is not available in the export and no fixture is treated as neutral
comparator.assertion: for every fixture with raw_delta != 0, elo_delta / raw_delta == 0.14 within 1e-9; when raw_delta == 0, elo_delta must be 0; any violation fails closed before scoring

challenger.fit: L2-regularised Poisson regression by IRLS, lambda_l2 = 1.0, max_iter = 100, tol = 1e-10, deterministic, no random seed used
challenger.temperature: fitted on the training prefix only, on 1X2 probabilities, by scalar grid search over [0.50, 1.50] step 0.01 minimising training multiclass log loss
challenger.temperature_scope: 1X2 only; it must NOT be silently extended to the five-state primary
challenger.refit_data: training prefix only; validation outcomes are never read during fitting
challenger.no_result_based_retry: the fit runs once; no retry, fallback, or hyperparameter change based on any observed metric

primary_estimand.statistic: per-fixture paired five-state NLL difference d_i = NLL_comparator_i - NLL_challenger_i
primary_estimand.reporting: stratified by market and line type; pooled primary retains UNLABELLED league fixtures

futility_rule.order: MUST be computed and reported BEFORE any validation five-state score is read
futility_rule.method: from the training prefix only, estimate the per-fixture SD of d_i at the frozen models, then compute the detectable effect at the validation N with clustered SE
futility_rule.stop_condition: if the detectable effect exceeds MME, return INSUFFICIENT_POWER_DO_NOT_SCORE and do not read validation scores

mme.note: carried over from the Penaltyblog programme as the minimum meaningful five-state NLL improvement; frozen here before any result access

authorisation_boundary: No conclusion authorises production replacement, champion promotion, or writing any fitted artefact into the production path.
